theme.title: Seattle's crown
theme.subtitle: Seattle SuperSonics, 1978–79
theme.recap: Lenny Wilkens's Sonics survived Phoenix in seven games and avenged their Finals loss to Washington to claim Seattle's NBA title.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Seattle win on its 1979 title run?

funFacts.text: Coach Lenny Wilkens guided the Seattle team from the Kingdome sidelines.
Finals MVP Dennis Johnson also made the All-Defensive First Team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dennis Johnson, NBA All-Defensive First Team

funFacts.text: Seattle beat Washington in the Finals after losing to the Bullets the previous year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Sonics would go on to avenge their NBA Finals loss and defeat the Bullets

questions.prompt: How many games did Seattle win in January of its 1979 championship season?
questions.note: Ten wins in January, powered by strong road form.

funFacts.text: Seattle won seven January road games and lost only once away from home.
The Sonics won a tight January game at Washington, a preview of the Finals matchup.
The Sonics also won a tight January game on the road in Phoenix.

questions.prompt: How many points did Jack Sikma score in Game 7 against Phoenix in 1979?
questions.context: Seattle · Western Conference finals · deciding game
questions.note: 33 points from Sikma to put Seattle into the Finals.

funFacts.text: Fred Brown led the Sonics with five assists in the winner-take-all contest.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: May 17 Phoenix W 114–110 Jack Sikma (33) Jack Sikma (11) Fred Brown (5)

funFacts.text: Over thirty-seven thousand fans watched Seattle survive the deciding game.
The Sonics advanced to face the defending champion Washington Bullets again.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: facing the defending NBA champion Washington Bullets

questions.prompt: How many points did Gus Williams score in overtime Game 4 of the 1979 Finals?
questions.note: 36 points in a pivotal overtime win.

funFacts.text: The game needed overtime before Seattle escaped with a win.
John Johnson dished out 13 assists in the same Game 4.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: May 29 Washington W 114–112 (OT) Gus Williams (36) Jack Sikma (17) John Johnson (13)

funFacts.text: The victory put Seattle one win away from the championship.

questions.prompt: How many rebounds did Jack Sikma grab in the 1979 title-clinching Game 5?
questions.note: 17 rebounds in Seattle's road championship clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: June 1 @ Washington W 97–93 Gus Williams (23) Jack Sikma (17)

funFacts.text: Gus Williams led Seattle in the clincher with 23 points.
Seattle won the final game 97–93 in Washington.
The victory secured Seattle's first NBA championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winning their first and only NBA championship
